# Overview

The current operational landscape at PURE FINANCIAL ADVISORS LLC involves collaboration across data, technology, and marketing teams, all contributing to pipeline and customer acquisition reporting activities. The core processes are supported by a suite of systems and platforms including Salesforce, Tamarac, Azure Blob Storage, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Power BI, with planned integration of QuickBooks.

PURE’s reporting and analytics needs are served through an established Power BI reporting suite, leveraging data from Salesforce, Tamarac, Azure Blob Storage, and QuickBooks. The cloud and data platform infrastructure is anchored by Microsoft Fabric and Azure Synapse. Integration efforts are presently focused on connecting and ingesting data from QuickBooks, with an additional emphasis on assessing data quality as part of current Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) reporting initiatives. No manual processes have been detailed in the current documentation.
